lines_of_business: Commercial (incl. Essential Plan, Child Health Plus), Medicaid without eMedNY criteria, Medicare without national/local decision (Product Disclaimer, p.1)
sections_in_order: Description (Rutherford classification table, CRPS, CCS classification)
criteria_location: Policy Statement I-XII pp.1-4 and Policy Guidelines pp.4-5; Rutherford and CCS tables in Description (pp.5-6) are needed to apply the CLI and angina criteria.
procedures_covered: SCS trial and permanent (standard and high-frequency) for FBSS with leg pain
Non-HF SCS for critical limb ischemia
Non-HF SCS for refractory angina (CCS III/IV)
Burst, closed-loop, DRG, peripheral nerve field stimulation (investigational)

logic.top_level: pathways (separate indications: FBSS, CRPS, CLI, angina) each with trial criteria (all-of) and permanent criteria (response)

k_of_n.quote: Patient reports at least one of the symptoms in three out of four of the following categories
patient displays at least one of the signs in two or more of the following categories

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Statements VI-XII list investigational uses (phantom limb, post-herpetic neuralgia, peripheral neuropathy, MS pain, etc.), plus 'no other medical or psychological diagnoses ... concordant' for CRPS and behavioral health attestation.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: V: replacement when malfunctioning, cannot be repaired, out of warranty, OR revision of electrodes needed. VI: replacing functioning non-HF SCS with HF is not medically necessary.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Surgical intervention is not indicated, or the patient does not wish to proceed with spinal surgery
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Patient preference substitutes for clinical indication (FBSS only; CRPS requires only 'not indicated')

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Patient has failed at least six consecutive months of physician-supervised, conservative medical management (e.g., pharmacotherapy, physical therapy, cognitive therapy, and activity lifestyle modification)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and' in the e.g. list vs 'or' in the CRPS copy ('cognitive behavioral therapy, or activity lifestyle modification'): all, any, or one?

extraction_hazards: Four nested levels (I.A.1.b.i) with lowercase letters and roman numerals
Criteria split between Policy Statement and Policy Guidelines (6-month refractory duration and 50% documentation live only in guidelines)
Rutherford and CCS tables are in Description, referenced by 'see below'
Page breaks fall mid-list (II.A at top of p.2)
Statement VII lists investigational conditions in letter items
interesting_structures: Four separate indication pathways each with trial and permanent stage
k-of-n symptom/sign categories (3 of 4, 2 of 4) like Budapest CRPS criteria
Objective vascular thresholds (ankle/toe pressure) via Rutherford
Optimal medical therapy list with BP and HR goals
Device-mode rules: HF only for FBSS; dual-mode equivalence; burst, closed-loop, DRG investigational

fit_to_tree.why: Rich but explicit: all/any plus k-of-n are expressible. Strain comes from depth, cross-references to guidelines and tables, and attestation leaves a chart rarely shows.
